changelog: Say "formalize the text" or "make it formal" — or "ফরমাল করো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the whole dictated message is rewritten in a formal, professional tone through Gemini with your own key. Gboard's Pixel 9+ writing-tools "Professional" command, the rewrite half of the family v11.5's "fix it" proofread left out — the fix for a message dictated casually for a client, a boss or an elder. In Bengali the rewrite uses the respectful আপনি form.
